profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: A Software developer enthusiast with 6 years of experience in Web Application Development using .NET 6.0 and JavaScript Technologies.

positions.title: Application Development Analyst
positions.description:
-	Tech Stack: SQL, C#, ASP.net, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, SharePoint 2010/2013, O365
-	Worked on development of web applications using ASP.net, C# in 4.5 framework.
-	Worked as SQL developer for managing the backend applications of US-based Pharmaceutical client.
-	UI development using HTML, CSS, JQuery, JavaScript.
-	Analyzed data flowing into the backend system from multiple sources for its congruence with the business requirement.
-	Worked on SharePoint 2010 and 2013 environment in creating and maintaining Sites Collection, sites and libraries.
-	Created complex Workflows and Infopath forms to meet the business requirements.
